sections.heading: Do British citizens need a Papua New Guinea visa?
sections.text: British passport holders need a visa to visit Papua New Guinea. Tourist visas can be applied for online as an eVisa before travelling.

sections.heading: Papua New Guinea visa for other passport holders
sections.text: UK residents on other passports usually apply the same way. Business visits and work need different visas and supporting letters.

sections.heading: Before you travel to Papua New Guinea
sections.text: Read the UK government travel advice for Papua New Guinea, have your return flight and accommodation details ready, and allow plenty of time for processing.

sections.heading: Papua New Guinea visa help from Manchester
sections.text: We're based in Manchester city centre and handle Papua New Guinea visa applications for travellers across the UK, entirely online. We check the current rules for your nationality, complete your application and keep you updated until it's approved. Before you travel, read the UK government's [foreign travel advice](https://www.gov.uk/foreign-travel-advice) for Papua New Guinea.

faqs.q: Do British citizens need a visa for Papua New Guinea?
faqs.a: Yes. Tourists can apply online for an eVisa before travelling.

faqs.q: How long does a Papua New Guinea visa take?
faqs.a: Usually a few working days, but processing times vary. Apply at least a week before you travel, and earlier in busy seasons.

faqs.q: Can you apply for my Papua New Guinea visa for me?
faqs.a: Yes. Use our online form: upload your passport and we fill in your details, then we complete and check the Papua New Guinea visa application and submit it for you.
